title: Compose Through a Client
description: The game contract needs to read a player's token balance and later transfer a fee. Contracts cannot call another contract's Rust functions in-process; composition goes through a generated client that dispatches host calls.
hint: A `#[contractclient]` module exposes a `Client` whose constructor takes the environment and the target contract's `Address`. Calls on that client are cross-contract host calls, so they cost resources and can fail; import the crate that defines the interface rather than re-declaring it. Directly invoking the other contract's Rust functions would only run local code and touch no state.
author: StellarHunts Core

testCases.title: Generated client bound to the token address
No environment means no host access
The client is not constructed from the caller
A client is not a contract module function
